Save this link to your bookmarks:

javascript:void(open('https://voat.co/submit?linkpost=true&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location)))

when you're reading a news article that you want to post to Voat, click the bookmark. It will open a new tab with the "submit link" pre-filled with the current URL. All you have to do is fill in the title and the name of the sub to post to.

All I did was take the bookmarklet that Archive.is uses and modified it with Voat's link submission URL. Nothing fancy, but useful.

here's a modified bookmarklet that will archive the URL in the current tab and open a new tab to submit to Voat at the same time, courtesy of /u/Pepperspray. Much appreciated!

javascript:(function(){window.location= 'https://archive.is/?run=1&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location);window.open('https://voat.co/submit?linkpost=true&url='+encodeURIComponent(document.location))})()
